title: refactor(ci): modernize lint/test/release workflows, consolidate actions, and bump deps
author: Ravi Desai
description: Motivation: consolidate and modernize CI workflows to reduce maintenance overhead, improve cache hit rates, and speed up lint/test/release pipelines. This PR collapses duplicated workflow files, upgrades core GitHub Actions and Node toolchains, and centralizes reusable steps into a shared actions/ directory. Goals: 1) reduce total CI runtime on PRs by ~25% on average, 2) improve cache hit rate across build matrix, 3) simplify release automation for repo hygiene. Changes include bumping node versions used in JS SDK builds (Node 20 LTS), updating actions (checkout, setup-node, cache), and removing legacy single-repo pipelines that duplicated work across packages. Checklist: - [x] consolidate lint/test flows into .github/workflows/ci.yml - [x] extract reusable steps to .github/actions/ - [x] bump GitHub Actions versions where safe (actions/checkout@v4, setup-node@v4) - [x] upgrade Node matrices where test coverage is green (node 18 -> node 20 where supported) - [x] validate release automation (tagging, changelog generation) in staging repo - [x] run full monorepo CI on a few large PRs for confirmation Rollback plan: revert the workflow file and action changes in a rollback PR if regressions show increased CI runtime or cache regressions. Related Linear tasks: ENG-2104, ENG-2140. Related PRs: pr-214999 (previous CI consolidation), pr-216999 (release automation tweaks). Notes: some legacy packages still run Node 18 due to pinned dependencies; this PR leaves explicit pin comments and a follow-up ticket to finish those upgrades.
